transcript: It was Priya's birthday. We did dinner at this tiny Italian place with string lights over the patio. Eight of us at one long table, way too much pasta. The waiters brought out a tiramisu with a sparkler and sang. After, we walked to the bay and someone played guitar on the pier.

spec.moment: The waiters bringing out a tiramisu with a glittering sparkler to the patio table under string lights.

elements.name: tiramisu with sparkler
elements.look: a square dusted dessert topped with a bright glittering sparkler casting warm light

elements.name: patio string lights
elements.look: small glowing golden bulbs strung overhead on dark wires

elements.name: long dining table
elements.look: a rustic wooden table crowded with bowls of pasta and wine glasses

elements.name: birthday friend
elements.look: a seated figure in a bright yellow dress smiling towards the dessert

elements.name: waiter
elements.look: a figure in a crisp white shirt and black apron presenting the glowing plate

spec.scene: A warm brick patio floor holds a long wooden dining table crowded with red bowls of pasta, wine glasses, and bread baskets. Overhead, crisscrossed string lights glow with soft amber light. At the center of the table sits an oversized square tiramisu glowing beneath a fizzing golden sparkler. A figure in a yellow dress sits beside it, while a waiter in a white shirt and dark apron leans in from the left holding the dessert platter. Two friends sit opposite in teal and olive sweaters.
spec.title: A Sparkler for Priya
spec.caption: We sang around the sparkler and ate way too much pasta.
